# limen_bot (Data Source)

Reads one bot. A Limen bot: a machine identity that logs in with a CI platform's workload identity token (ADR-0019). Bots are written only by people, through Git or the console, so Terraform can read them but not write them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "limen_bot" "example" {
  name = "example-bot"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The bot's name.

### Optional

- `policy_version` (Number) Read from this past policy version instead of the active one. Afterwards, the version the revision read first appeared in.

### Read-Only

- `channel` (String) How its owner writes it: `git`, `console`, or `api`.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Free text.
- `effective_labels` (Map of String) What roles select on.
- `effective_spec` (Dynamic) What enforcement uses, as a value.
- `effective_spec_json` (String) What enforcement uses, as JSON.
- `etag` (String) Changes whenever the document or its owner changes.
- `id` (String) The name.
- `labels` (Map of String) The labels its writer set.
- `namespace` (String) The owner's namespace.
- `profile` (String) For a resource, the profile it completes; otherwise empty.
- `source` (String) The owner's source.
- `spec` (Dynamic) The spec its writer set, as a value: `.spec.postgres.endpoint` and so on.
- `spec_json` (String) The same, as normalized JSON.
- `updated_at` (String) When this revision was written (RFC 3339).
- `updated_by` (String) Who wrote this revision.
